about: Speaker patterns for Claude Code (2.6). Each pattern matches one tag or one wrapper line by its shape, never a list of words, and carries its own tests. element: <name ...>...</name>, nested ones of the same name counted, one left open running to the end. element_prefix: every element whose name starts with it. line_prefix: a line that starts with the wrapper's own fixed text. delivers: the one harness element the desktop delivers other sessions' messages inside, mid-turn, each right after the line delivers_after names (a reminder also shows files read or changed, and a tag in them is dropped); a relayed element inside it is relayed, and inside any other harness element (command output, a task notice, Quelvio's own blocks) it is dropped with the rest. Tests run in an interactive session unless they say otherwise; rows are [speaker, text] or [speaker, text, sender, sender_kind].
